title: check:skills verifies the commands and files a skill names; releases list skills touching changed files
goal: A release cannot silently leave a skill pointing at a renamed script, tool or document
acceptance: check:skills fails when a skill names an npm script, tools/*.mjs or docs path absent from the release
The release notes list skills that mention a file the release changed, for a re-read
privacy: Procedure and config text only; examples invented; no personal data.
escalation: A discovery rule that would make the harness own a project's skills goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-23 at agent speed. Not a measurement.
